description: VerkeersInformatie Locatie Database is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ndw.nu. The VILD (Traffic Information Location Database) is used to ensure unambiguous and uniform location information in the traffic information chains in the Netherlands. The VILD is used by Rijkswaterstaat and all road operators affiliated with NDW to include location information in the published traffic and travel information. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic Information Location Database" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Verkeersinformatie, Verkeer, Locatie, VILD. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
